/home/hyl/.virtualenvs/llm_app/bin/python -B -c 'import hashlib, json, pathlib, re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
work=pathlib.Path(".superpowers/sdd/2026-09-12-sec-research-release-integration")
records=[]
for path in sorted(work.glob("task7-*/command.json")):
    r=json.loads(path.read_text())
    log=path.parent/"output.log"
    raw=log.read_text()
    clean=re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*m","",raw)
    xml=path.parent/"results.xml"
    counts=None
    failed=[]
    if xml.exists():
        tree=ET.parse(xml)
        cases=tree.findall(".//testcase")
        counts=dict(executed=len(cases),failed=sum(c.find("failure") is not None for c in cases),errors=sum(c.find("error") is not None for c in cases),skipped=sum(c.find("skipped") is not None for c in cases))
        counts["passed"]=counts["executed"]-counts["failed"]-counts["errors"]-counts["skipped"]
        failed=[dict(owner=c.attrib.get("classname"),name=c.attrib["name"]) for c in cases if c.find("failure") is not None or c.find("error") is not None]
    summaries=[line.strip() for line in clean.splitlines() if re.search(r"^\s*(?:\d+ (?:failed|passed|skipped)|Tests\s|Test Files\s)|browser_cases|candidateCount",line)]
    records.append(dict(name=r["name"],command=r["command"],cwd=r["cwd"],exit_code=r["exit_code"],seconds=r["seconds"],command_receipt=str(path),log=str(log),command_sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),log_sha256=hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),junit=str(xml) if xml.exists() else None,junit_sha256=hashlib.sha256(xml.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if xml.exists() else None,counts=counts,failed_cases=failed,summary_lines=summaries[-3:],act_warning_count=clean.count("not configured to support act(")))
print(json.dumps(records))
'
